name: recoder
description: AI-powered development platform with production-ready code generation

scripts.install:packages: cd packages/cli && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install && cd ../../backend && npm install && cd ../production-engine && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:cli && npm run build:backend && npm run build:engine
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm run build || echo 'Backend build not configured'
scripts.build:web: cd packages/web && npm run build || echo 'Web build not configured'
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:cli" "npm run dev:web" --names "backend,engine,cli,web" --prefix-colors "blue,green,cyan,magenta"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npm run dev || node src/server.js
scripts.dev:engine: cd production-engine && npm run dev || node src/server.js
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && npm start || node src/server.js
scripts.start:engine: cd production-engine && npm start || node dist/server.js
scripts.test:cli: cd packages/cli && npm test || echo 'CLI tests not configured'
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && npm test || echo 'Backend tests not configured'
scripts.test:engine: cd production-engine && npm test || echo 'Engine tests not configured'
scripts.test:full: npm run build && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint:cli: cd packages/cli && npm run lint || echo 'CLI lint not configured'
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && npm run lint || echo 'Backend lint not configured'
scripts.lint:engine: cd production-engine && npm run lint || echo 'Engine lint not configured'
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/cli && npm run typecheck || echo 'Typecheck not configured'
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/*/node_modules backend/node_modules production-engine/node_modules packages/*/dist backend/dist production-engine/dist
scripts.unlink:cli: cd packages/cli && npm unlink -g || echo 'CLI not linked'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run test && docker-compose up -d
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Run npm run setup for full setup'

author: Recoder Team
